title: Notice to Government for Grab Holdings' Recent Decision to Cut 1,000 Jobs
what_it_is: Notice to Government for Grab Holdings' Recent Decision to Cut 1,000 Jobs

sections.label: Grab retrenchment notifications and support
sections.summary: MOM received Grab's retrenchment notifications within five working days, and DISG, the Taskforce, WSG, NTUC, e2i and e2i are facilitating affected staff transitions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry has also received their Mandatory Retrenchment Notifications (MRNs) which were submitted within five working days after affected employees were notified of their retrenchment, as legally required under the Employment Act.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Based on the retrenchment notifications received by MOM, the workforce profile of Grabtaxi Holdings before and after the retrenchment exercise is largely similar.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Digital Industry Singapore (DISG) is working with the Taskforce for Responsible Retrenchment and Employment Facilitation, comprising representatives from MOM, the Workforce Singapore (WSG), National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) and NTUC’s Employment and Employability Institute (e2i), to facilitate a smooth transition of the affected staff.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In particular, e2i is in touch with Grabtaxi Holdings and has offered career coaching services, employability workshops and other employment facilitation initiatives.

sections.label: Infocomm vacancies and unemployment rates
sections.summary: The March 2023 report shows about 8,100 infocomm job vacancies, with unemployment at 1.8% and long-term unemployment at 0.6%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: To the Member's question as well, overall, whether we think there is softness in the sector, if you look at the recent report in March 2023, the number of job vacancies in the infocomm sector remains high at about 8,100 in March 2023.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, tech skills are pretty much in demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But as a whole, just to put things into context as well, we are at a very low unemployment rate – we are at 1.8% unemployment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: If you look at the data on long-term unemployment, it is 0.6%.

sections.label: Support for laid-off employees
sections.summary: The key is to ensure laid-off employees get opportunities, career counselling and facilitation to return to jobs quickly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: What is key is to ensure that employees being laid off are given opportunities, career counselling and are facilitated to get back into a job as soon as possible.
